name: wisepim
description: Audit catalog quality, prepare native translations, and review channel readiness with WisePIM.

interface.longDescription: Inspect product quality, review available channel-readiness evidence, and prepare native WisePIM translations. Each connection belongs to one project. Consequential actions require approval in WisePIM; queued work is reported separately from completed results.
defaultPrompt: Find products with missing catalog content.
Prepare German translations for these products.
Review evidence that these products are ready for a sales channel.
